vector_memory.semantic_summary: This utility module manages the serialization and deserialization of terrain data between various formats. It provides functions to convert the internal TerrainGrid structure into standardized 16-bit heightmaps (.r16) or 8-bit RGBA image representations. Key operations include calculating grid bounds, exporting the full terrain heightmap, and importing external heightmap data using bilinear interpolation for smooth integration.
